description: Native syn projects an unstable Rust trait alias as a named top-level owner; an alias edit merges with an independent function edit.

input.base:
pub trait Sendable = Send + Sync;
fn stable() -> i32 { 1 }
input.ours:
pub trait Sendable = Send + Sync + 'static;
fn stable() -> i32 { 1 }
input.theirs:
pub trait Sendable = Send + Sync;
fn stable() -> i32 { 2 }

expected.output:
pub trait Sendable = Send + Sync + 'static;
fn stable() -> i32 { 2 }
